caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a carved, decorative back and cabriole legs, rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown. The backrest features an intricate geometric pattern with curved and intersecting elements, and there is a central pierced oval design near the seat. The seat is upholstered, covered in a light blue patterned fabric with some floral or abstract motifs in muted tones such as beige and orange. In addition to the main chair, the drawing includes two detailed views in the top left corner: an upper view of the backrest design and a close-up of the lower pierced section of the backrest and rear seat rail. Both details closely match the wood color and carving style of the chair shown in full on the right side of the page. The composition is on a plain, off-white background, and there is a fine black border framing the entire drawing. The artist’s name, Frances Law Durand, is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Chair
